thread:
maya: Heads-up — support ticket shows a big customer (acct: acme-corp) getting 502/504s and timeouts hitting /v1/generate since 08:12 UTC. Lots of concurrent failures, P50 latency spiking to 8s. Creating war room.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-6789. Pager notified.
sanjay: I'm on it. Initial ask: any recent deploys to hosted inference in eu-west-1? alex: not from runtime team — last deploy was a minor routing config change at 07:50 by infra.
lia: Support forwarded sample request IDs: req_3fa1, req_3fa2, req_3fa7. Responses show upstream gateway 502 with message: "kv-cache-miss + inference timeout"
evan-support: Customer says failures started after a burst of larger batched requests; they saw partial success then cascades. They're on dedicated plan but hitting hosted fallback.
maya: Repro steps from support: run the same payload (size ~12k tokens) against /v1/generate with concurrency 30. They attached curl and logs.
alex: Can someone paste the curl? I'll try repro in staging.
lia: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl-quant","input":"<~12k tokens>","max_tokens":1024}'
```
maya: Running this locally causes svc-proxy to return 504 after 10s. Logs show upstream runtime returning ECONNRESET on some connections.
sanjay: Observed same in eu-west staging: connection pool exhaustion on model-inference pool. KV cache eviction rate spikes when large prefix sizes are used -> memory pressure -> connections closed.
alex: Temporary mitigation: increase proxy connection pool size + drop large-batch routing to dedicated rare-path. Pushing a quick config change to increase keepalive and pool size for hosted endpoints.
ops-bot: Deploy started: infra/configscale v2026.03. Patch applied to proxy in eu-west-1 at 08:40 UTC.
lia: Post-patch: we've seen 502s fall by ~70% for sampled traffic; still some residual 504s under heavy burst.
evan-support: Customer confirmed partial recovery, but requests with very large input still time out.
maya: Action item list (short):
- sanjay: investigate KV cache eviction policy and whether large-prefix workloads should be backpressured (due: 48h)
- alex: roll permanent proxy config + autoscale rule for model pools (due: 24h)
- lia: follow up with customer on recommended payload limits and provide temporary rate-limit knobs (due: 2h)
- evan-support: gather full request logs and customer timeline (due: 1h)
- maya: own postmortem and update playbook for large-batch fallback (due: 72h)
sanjay: Quick observation — request header X-Batch-Size >= 8 correlates with >90% of failures. We can add an automated fallback to smaller micro-batches at the gateway while we fix runtime.
alex: I'll prototype a gateway-level batch-splitter that turns large batches into sequential micro-batches for hosted to avoid one request monopolizing the pool. Can ship as feature flag for canary in 12h.
maya: Until then, adding a temporary circuit-breaker that rejects batches > 6 with a clear 429 + guidance to retry will protect the fleet. Lia — can we add customer-facing messaging? evan-support: Yep, will send template and apply to the account and docs.
lia: Template: "We detected unusually large batched requests causing timeout cascades. Please reduce batch size to <=6 or contact us to enable staged micro-batching."
maya: Note for postmortem: investigate why KV cache evictions align with pooling resets. If eviction causes runtime to reload weights or GC, that could blow connections.
sanjay: Collected metrics: kv_cache_evictions spike at 08:11, model-pool-active-conns at capacity at 08:12, and downstream 502/504 spike aligned. I'll attach graphs.
ops-bot: Reminder: add postmortem label and severity: S2 (customer impact, partial degradation). maya: confirmed.
evans-support: Customer will accept temporary 429 per batch while we stabilize; they asked for ETA on permanent fix.
maya: ETA: initial permanent fix (proxy autoscale + pool tuning) ~24h, micro-batch feature flag ~12-36h, KV eviction root cause ~48-72h.
alex: I'll also add an automated alert: if pool utilization >90% and kv_cache_evictions > threshold for 1m, trigger page to eng-runtime.
lia: Closing notes: support will send a summary to the customer and schedule a follow-up call in 4 hours. I'll track comms.
maya: I'll draft the postmortem and post follow-up tasks into the incidents board. Thanks team :thumbsup:
